name: MaxionBench-Portable evaluation card
evaluation_object: Agentic retrieval infrastructure under conformance-gated, single-node local deployment assumptions.
primary_claim: Agentic retrieval systems require decision-audit evaluation across conformance, quality, freshness, tail latency, task cost, budget stability, and objective sensitivity.

supported_claims.claim: Strict 200 ms p99 deployment selects FAISS CPU with bge-small for S1, S2, and S3 in the archived local run bundle.
supported_claims.scope: single local machine, archived portable bundle
reported portable objectives and budget rows

supported_claims.claim: The S3 pgvector quality-first edge is not substantive under matched-query audit.
S2 Qdrant does not hide a quality/freshness win in the paired checks.
supported_claims.scope: standard Qdrant sanity check, bounded same-orchestration mini-bundle, and larger same-machine two-repeat paired check

not_supported: claims about managed vector database deployments

datasets.name: D4 portable S1/S2 processed text bundles

compute_scope.python: 3.11.14 in the archived manuscript metadata; local current environment may differ

known_limitations: Only one local hardware profile is included.
The S2 same-machine reruns cap freshness events for deadline turnaround.
The artifact evaluates retrieval infrastructure, not generated answer quality.
Dataset hosting URLs must be anonymized and finalized before submission.
